intro: Explore a fallen kingdom as a masked adventurer. Master jumps, dashes, wall-climbing and powerful attacks as you battle through the dungeon and confront the Nameless King.
description:
Enter the ruins of a long-fallen kingdom and uncover the dangers hidden within its forgotten dungeon.

You take control of a mysterious masked adventurer on a journey through an interconnected world filled with hazardous passages, challenging platforming sections and hostile creatures. Explore the dungeon in your chosen order, discover new paths and prepare for an inevitable confrontation with the nameless king.

Master a responsive set of movement abilities, including double jumps, rapid dashes and wall-climbing. Combine these skills to cross dangerous gaps, climb towering chambers and reach areas hidden throughout the kingdom.

When enemies stand in your way, fight back using quick combo attacks or charge a powerful special move that unleashes explosive damage across the surrounding area. Choose the right moment to strike, avoid incoming attacks and survive each encounter.

Rest at bonfires to restore your strength and establish new checkpoints as you descend deeper into the ruins. Every chamber brings you closer to the ruler waiting at the end of your journey.

Features:

• Explore an interconnected 2D dungeon
• Run, double-jump, dash and climb walls
• Battle enemies using combos and special attacks
• Rest at bonfires to heal and save your progress
• Discover multiple routes through the fallen kingdom
• Face the nameless king in a final boss battle

The kingdom has fallen, but its ruler remains. Will you survive the descent?
